**`hooks/src/index.js`** — adapted the upstream fix (preactjs/preact#3567, fixing #3569) to this repo's `hookRunner`-based hooks implementation:
- `useEffect`/`useLayoutEffect` (via `hookRunner.process`, hooks/src/index.js:88-95) now store new deps as `state._pendingArgs` instead of committing `state._args` immediately.
- `useMemo` (hooks/src/index.js:315-324) stores computed value/deps as `_pendingValue`/`_pendingArgs` and returns the pending value until committed.
- During a repeated render (state settling, when `previousComponent === currentComponent`), pending args/values are now *cleared* instead of force-clearing `_args`, so effects that already committed don't re-run their cleanup (hooks/src/index.js:137-149).
- Pending args/values are committed to `_args`/`_value` at commit time (hooks/src/index.js:100-111) and at the start of a fresh render (hooks/src/index.js:151-159).

**`hooks/src/internal.d.ts`** — added `_pendingArgs`/`_pendingValue` fields.
